html:
Get ready for the summer season

If you’ve been thinking about getting your home windows tinted, now’s the time to act. With the weather warming up, speak to Brisbane’s home window tinting experts at Tint a Car to give your home a refreshing new look in time for the summer season.

What’s more, with a large range of home window tint film to choose from, you’re never out of options either.

Discover our house window tinting range

Solar Window Film

Decorative Window Film

Safety & Security Film

Anti-Graffiti Window Film

Arrange a FREE Quote

Benefits of house window tinting

  • Safety and Security Film – with up to seven times the thickness of standard window film, give your home a virtually bullet proof level of protection against break-ins.
    Available in clear or tinted options for you to choose from. Ideal for rooms in the home that are prone to break-ins such as laundries or back sliding doors or windows.
  • Decorative Window Film – fully customisable house window tint that could be applied for both exterior and interior surfaces. With a custom design service available for this range of tint film, create your own designs with graphics, logos and more for that ultimate personalised look.
    Unleash the interior decorator in you and give your home that unique look!

View our range in store

Find your nearest store to take a look at film samples and see what really can be done with window film for your home or office!
